A '''Cerean Puzzle Cube''' was a cube-shaped item<ref name="SiG" /> that shared its name with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|116|Cerea}}</ref> The item could be purchased from [[Nenmo's Curios]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] while the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]]<ref name="SiG" /> the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]<ref name="LFGuide">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> for two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]<ref name="SiG" /> around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="31 BBY">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' dates the beginning of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign, which includes ''[[Shadows in Green]]'', to one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the events of {{Film|I}}, which translates to [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

The shop, owned by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Nenmo]], had six Cerean Puzzle Cubes available for purchase. Although their price was listed as fifty [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]], it was considered exorbitant as Nenmo expected potential customers to haggle on the price of all of his products. The cube and the rest of the Toydarian's inventory were sourced from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SiG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cerean Puzzle Cube appeared in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' one-shot adventure ''[[Shadows in Green]]'', which was written by [[Lee Pickler]] and was part of the larger [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign.<ref name="SiG" />
